nonclaims: A scenario bundle is an auditable replicated-study instrument, not a power analysis, significance test, causal estimate, ethics review, or proof that Lacuna improves fiction or science.

The host-generated schedule and assignment seeds are locally committed; external witness records are operator-supplied descriptions and Lacuna does not validate their signatures, timestamps, service identity, inclusion, or availability.
A same-host owner can inspect private assignments or discard an unwitnessed bundle; direct child contamination can be detected but not undone.
Provider, model, context, invocation, timing, token, cost, and failure fields remain host declarations unless independently attested.
Distinct context IDs, separate chats, and named subagents do not prove independent memory, tool isolation, or absence of collusion.
Structured blind packets omit condition labels but cannot guarantee semantic anonymity, rater independence, or absence of method leakage.
Exact seed cloning controls durable Lacuna state, not hidden provider prompts, system state, tools, model updates, or external memory.
Whole-directory publication and cooperative locks are same-filesystem coordination, not distributed transactions or hostile-user confinement.
Revision 0162 supplies a falsifiable replicated instrument and hyperlegible operating entrances; it does not report a completed multi-provider Gwern evaluation.
acceptance_note: Rev0162 preserves database schema 8 and event schema 1 while adding preregistered multi-block scenario custody, precreated child assignments and clones, public commitment and optional witness gates, one-active-block operation, blind block seals, all-at-once crash-resumable unblinding, deterministic rater-level exports, shared clone/sidecar primitives, and explicit provider/subagent entrances.
